scope: Prevent the adapter from reporting complete output after a non-DXF ACAD_PROXY_ENTITY callback that currently has no qualified DXF replay route, while preserving DXF-origin exact raw-carrier retention.

behavior: dx_iface now overrides addProxyEntity. For DWG or otherwise non-DXF input, it stores a sticky output-refusal marker instead of silently ignoring the callback.
fileExport rejects the marker during preflight with an explicit incomplete-output diagnostic, before replacing or publishing the destination.
DXF-origin typed proxy callbacks do not set the marker; their paired raw entity callback remains captured in the existing source-order replay stream.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed DRW_ProxyEntity callback models and a locally constructed raw DXF carrier; temporary destination sentinels only. No DWG/DXF fixture files were added.
assertions: A DWG-origin proxy callback sets the sticky unsupported-output marker.
ASCII and Binary export both refuse before replacing an existing destination.
A DXF-origin proxy callback leaves the refusal marker clear and the paired raw carrier is retained in the modelspace raw-record sequence.

validation.fixturePolicy: No investigation or test drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: This closes a silent omission path only; no DWG proxy bytes are serialized into DXF by this slice.
Exact proxy class/version mapping, object-ID roles, output graph closure, physical source-to-output proof, and native proxy meaning remain open.
DXF raw replay remains source-bound and is not generalized to DWG-origin proxy records.
No support claim is promoted; P4, P6 and P8 remain open.
